<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<meta name="description" content="Y Kroon Industrial Development &amp; Operations. Industrial design, engineering and hands-on prototyping.">
<title>Y Kroon | Industrial Development &amp; Operations</title>
<style>
:root{
  --bg:#f4f4f0;--ink:#111214;--muted:#6e7075;--line:rgba(17,18,20,.13);
  --dark:#0c0d0f;--dark2:#141518;--light:#f7f7f3;--accent:#f04452;
  --pad:clamp(20px,4.2vw,72px);--radius:22px;--max:1600px;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}html{scroll-behavior:smooth}body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}img,video{display:block;max-width:100%}.wrap{width:min(100%,var(--max));margin:auto;padding-inline:var(--pad)}

/* hero */
.hero{height:100svh;min-height:650px;position:relative;background:#050506;color:#fff;overflow:hidden}.hero video{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}.hero:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(0,0,0,.25),rgba(0,0,0,.05) 42%,rgba(0,0,0,.64));pointer-events:none}.topbar{position:absolute;z-index:2;left:0;right:0;top:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:24px var(--pad)}.logo{width:58px;height:auto}.nav{display:flex;gap:25px;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase}.nav a{opacity:.72}.nav a:hover{opacity:1}.hero-copy{position:absolute;z-index:2;left:var(--pad);right:var(--pad);bottom:clamp(30px,5vw,70px);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:end;gap:40px}.hero h1{margin:0;font-size:clamp(52px,8vw,128px);font-weight:500;line-height:.86;letter-spacing:-.07em}.hero-meta{margin:0 0 8px;max-width:240px;text-align:right;font-size:10px;line-height:1.5;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.75}

/* shared */
.section{padding:clamp(88px,10vw,155px) 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.eyebrow{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.17em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}.eyebrow:before{content:"";width:22px;height:1px;background:currentColor}.section-title{margin:18px 0 0;font-size:clamp(42px,6vw,92px);line-height:.92;letter-spacing:-.06em;font-weight:500}.intro{max-width:680px;margin:24px 0 0;font-size:clamp(16px,1.35vw,20px);line-height:1.55;color:#55585d;letter-spacing:-.015em}

/* about */
.about-card{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.15fr) minmax(260px,.85fr);gap:clamp(36px,8vw,120px);align-items:stretch}.about-copy{display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;min-height:410px}.about-copy .intro{max-width:590px}.about-visual{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius);min-height:410px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#ebece8,#f7f7f4)}.about-visual:before,.about-visual:after{content:"";position:absolute;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:50%}.about-visual:before{width:70%;aspect-ratio:1;right:-22%;top:-25%}.about-visual:after{width:42%;aspect-ratio:1;left:-10%;bottom:-20%}.about-placeholder{position:absolute;inset:auto 22px 22px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:end;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}

/* capabilities */
.capabilities{background:var(--dark);color:var(--light);border-bottom:none}.capabilities .eyebrow{color:#8c8e94}.capabilities .intro{color:#a8abb0}.cap-head{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(260px,.56fr);gap:50px;align-items:end}.software{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;justify-content:flex-end}.pill{padding:9px 12px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.17);border-radius:999px;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.11em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#c5c7cb;background:rgba(255,255,255,.025)}.skill-grid{margin-top:clamp(48px,6vw,84px);display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.13);border-left:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.13)}.skill{min-height:260px;padding:22px 22px 26px;border-right:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.13);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.13);display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;transition:background .25s ease}.skill:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.04)}.skill-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px}.skill-num{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.15em;color:var(--accent)}.skill-dot{width:6px;height:6px;background:var(--accent);border-radius:50%;opacity:.0;transition:opacity .25s}.skill:hover .skill-dot{opacity:1}.skill h3{margin:0 0 12px;font-size:clamp(20px,2vw,30px);letter-spacing:-.04em;font-weight:500}.skill p{margin:0;color:#979aa0;font-size:13px;line-height:1.48;max-width:280px}.skill-tags{margin-top:22px;display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap}.skill-tags span{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.11em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#777a80}

/* workshop */
.workshop-head{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr minmax(260px,.62fr);gap:60px;align-items:end}.workshop-grid{margin-top:clamp(45px,6vw,80px);display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:14px}.work-card{aspect-ratio:16/9;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius);background:#ecece8;position:relative;overflow:hidden;padding:22px;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;transition:transform .25s ease,background .25s}.work-card:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);background:#e6e6e1}.work-card:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(135deg,transparent 48%,rgba(17,18,20,.06) 48%,rgba(17,18,20,.06) 48.35%,transparent 48.35%)}.work-card .label{position:relative;z-index:1}.work-card small{display:block;font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:8px}.work-card strong{font-size:clamp(24px,3vw,44px);font-weight:500;letter-spacing:-.05em}.image-note{position:absolute;right:20px;top:20px;font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#999ba0}

/* work / infinite project explorer */
.project-explorer-section{padding-bottom:clamp(90px,10vw,150px);background:#121417;color:var(--light);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.10)}
.project-explorer-section .eyebrow{color:#8c8e94}
.project-explorer-section .intro{color:#a8abb0}
.project-explorer{margin-top:clamp(42px,6vw,78px)}
.explorer-chrome{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:24px;align-items:center;padding:0 2px 14px;font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#7d8086}
.explorer-window{--ambient-x:46%;--ambient-y:42%;position:relative;height:min(82vh,930px);min-height:680px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.10);border-radius:30px;background:#0d1014;cursor:grab;isolation:isolate;outline:none;touch-action:pan-y;box-shadow:0 28px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.18),inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.018);transform:translateZ(0);backface-visibility:hidden}
.explorer-window:focus-visible{box-shadow:0 34px 100px rgba(0,0,0,.22),inset 0 0 0 2px rgba(240,68,82,.7)}
.explorer-window.is-dragging{cursor:grabbing}
.explorer-window:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;background:radial-gradient(980px 760px at var(--ambient-x) var(--ambient-y),rgba(255,211,141,.115),transparent 70%),radial-gradient(920px 740px at 16% 86%,rgba(197,109,33,.12),transparent 72%),radial-gradient(980px 760px at 88% 14%,rgba(222,176,93,.11),transparent 72%),radial-gradient(680px 520px at 62% 40%,rgba(255,224,165,.055),transparent 66%),linear-gradient(145deg,#19120f 0%,#14100f 42%,#1b1411 100%)}
.explorer-window:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:8;pointer-events:none;background:radial-gradient(circle at center,transparent 44%,rgba(0,0,0,.10) 76%,rgba(0,0,0,.26) 100%);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,230,190,.03)}

/* Three spatial planes. Far objects have more blur and much more inertia. */
.parallax-layer{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:18000px;height:18000px;transform-origin:0 0;will-change:transform;pointer-events:none;contain:layout style;backface-visibility:hidden;transform-style:flat}
.parallax-far{z-index:1}.parallax-mid{z-index:2}.parallax-near{z-index:3}
.depth-object{--final-opacity:.32;position:absolute;left:var(--x);top:var(--y);transform:translate3d(-50%,-50%,0);opacity:0;pointer-events:auto;contain:paint;transition:transform .48s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),opacity .32s ease}
.depth-orb{width:var(--size,120px);height:var(--size,120px);border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(255,211,149,.16);background:radial-gradient(circle at 48% 45%,rgba(255,212,136,.56) 0 18%,rgba(219,158,84,.30) 28%,rgba(191,104,31,.42) 56%,rgba(85,40,13,.26) 72%,transparent 79%),radial-gradient(circle at 28% 24%,rgba(255,242,212,.28),transparent 26%),radial-gradient(circle at 76% 74%,rgba(255,150,54,.12),transparent 24%);box-shadow:inset -28px -34px 54px rgba(53,22,7,.34),inset 18px 22px 40px rgba(255,222,161,.06),0 18px 46px rgba(17,8,4,.18),0 0 46px rgba(255,132,33,.06)}
.depth-orb:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:18%;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 48%,rgba(255,220,162,.18),rgba(255,220,162,.04) 54%,transparent 70%);border:1px solid rgba(255,228,193,.08)}.depth-orb:after{content:"";position:absolute;left:18%;top:14%;width:28%;height:28%;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,250,241,.34),rgba(255,250,241,0) 72%);opacity:.8}
.depth-orb:hover{transform:translate3d(-50%,-50%,0) scale(1.18);opacity:min(1,calc(var(--final-opacity, .3) + .24));border-color:rgba(255,221,170,.34);box-shadow:inset -28px -34px 54px rgba(53,22,7,.36),0 0 0 1px rgba(255,215,160,.08),0 0 60px rgba(255,139,31,.12)}
.parallax-far .depth-object{--final-opacity:.14}
.parallax-mid .depth-object{--final-opacity:.25}
.parallax-near .depth-object{--final-opacity:.40}
.parallax-far .depth-orb{box-shadow:inset -10px -14px 28px rgba(43,18,7,.20),0 0 36px rgba(255,147,53,.03);border-color:rgba(255,214,160,.08)}
.parallax-mid .depth-orb{box-shadow:inset -18px -22px 34px rgba(48,19,7,.24),0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.10),0 0 42px rgba(255,129,30,.045)}

@keyframes archiveAssemble{
  0%{translate:var(--enter-x,0px) var(--enter-y,0px);rotate:var(--enter-rot,0deg);scale:var(--enter-scale,.82);opacity:0;animation-timing-function:cubic-bezier(.68,.01,.82,.22)}
  70%{translate:var(--mid-x,0px) var(--mid-y,0px);rotate:var(--mid-rot,0deg);scale:var(--mid-scale,1.015);opacity:var(--final-opacity,1);animation-timing-function:cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}
  100%{translate:0 0;rotate:0deg;scale:1;opacity:var(--final-opacity,1)}
}
.project-explorer.archive-ready .scene-enter{animation:archiveAssemble var(--enter-dur,2.2s) var(--enter-delay,0s) both}

.project-world{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:18000px;height:18000px;will-change:transform;transform:translate3d(0,0,0);transform-origin:0 0;z-index:4;backface-visibility:hidden;transform-style:flat}
.project-world:before{content:"SELECTED WORK / SPATIAL ARCHIVE";position:absolute;left:9000px;top:8835px;transform:translateX(-50%);font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.32em;color:rgba(255,255,255,.15);white-space:nowrap;pointer-events:none}

/* Year rings: every year is readable north/east/south/west. */
.timeline-axis{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:1;pointer-events:none}
.timeline-axis:has(.year-chip:hover),.timeline-axis:has(.year-chip:focus-visible){z-index:40}
.year-rings{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none}
.year-ring{--r:700px;position:absolute;left:9000px;top:9000px;width:calc(var(--r) * 2);height:calc(var(--r) * 2);translate:-50% -50%;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.075);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.006),inset 0 0 80px rgba(255,255,255,.006);opacity:0;scale:.82;transition:opacity 1.1s ease var(--delay),scale 1.8s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) var(--delay)}
.year-ring:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-1px;border-radius:50%;background:conic-gradient(from var(--spin,0deg),rgba(240,68,82,.22) 0 1deg,transparent 1deg 37deg,rgba(255,255,255,.15) 37deg 38deg,transparent 38deg 89deg,rgba(255,255,255,.08) 89deg 90deg,transparent 90deg 100%);-webkit-mask:radial-gradient(farthest-side,transparent calc(100% - 2px),#000 calc(100% - 1px));mask:radial-gradient(farthest-side,transparent calc(100% - 2px),#000 calc(100% - 1px));opacity:.8}
.year-ring.major{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.13);box-shadow:0 0 52px rgba(255,255,255,.012)}
.year-ring.current{border-color:rgba(240,68,82,.22)}
.project-explorer.timeline-ready .year-ring{opacity:1;scale:1}
.year-chip{position:absolute;pointer-events:auto;border:0;background:transparent;color:rgba(255,255,255,.62);padding:9px 12px;cursor:help;font:inherit;letter-spacing:-.055em;transition:transform .42s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),color .28s ease;z-index:2;outline:none}
.year-chip .year-text{display:block;font-size:82px;line-height:.8;font-weight:500;text-shadow:0 12px 38px rgba(0,0,0,.26)}
.year-chip .year-fact{position:absolute;left:50%;top:calc(100% + 14px);translate:-50% 6px;width:330px;padding:15px 17px;border:1px solid rgba(255,223,183,.16);border-radius:16px;background:rgba(26,18,13,.96);color:rgba(255,244,228,.90);font-size:13px;line-height:1.5;letter-spacing:.015em;text-align:left;opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transition:opacity .22s ease,translate .34s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);box-shadow:0 18px 52px rgba(0,0,0,.30);pointer-events:none}
.year-chip:hover,.year-chip:focus-visible{transform:scale(1.13);color:#fff}
.year-chip:hover .year-fact,.year-chip:focus-visible .year-fact{opacity:1;visibility:visible;translate:-50% 0}
.year-chip:focus-visible{outline:1px solid rgba(240,68,82,.8);outline-offset:4px;border-radius:10px}
.year-chip.north{left:50%;top:0;translate:-50% -50%}
.year-chip.east{left:100%;top:50%;translate:-50% -50%}
.year-chip.south{left:50%;top:100%;translate:-50% -50%}
.year-chip.west{left:0;top:50%;translate:-50% -50%}
.year-chip.south .year-fact{top:auto;bottom:calc(100% + 14px)}
.year-chip.east .year-fact{left:auto;right:calc(100% + 14px);top:50%;translate:6px -50%}
.year-chip.east:hover .year-fact,.year-chip.east:focus-visible .year-fact{translate:0 -50%}
.year-chip.west .year-fact{left:calc(100% + 14px);top:50%;translate:-6px -50%}
.year-chip.west:hover .year-fact,.year-chip.west:focus-visible .year-fact{translate:0 -50%}
.year-chip.current{color:rgba(255,255,255,.95)}
.year-chip.current .year-text:after{content:"NOW";display:block;margin-top:8px;font-size:7px;letter-spacing:.2em;color:var(--accent);text-align:center}

/* Circular projects remain the foreground layer. */
.project-bubble{--bw:336px;--tilt:0deg;--final-opacity:1;--final-filter:none;position:absolute;left:var(--x);top:var(--y);width:var(--bw);height:var(--bw);aspect-ratio:1;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(var(--tilt));border:1px solid rgba(255,214,166,.18);border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,176,94,.045);color:#fff;padding:0;overflow:hidden;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 22px 66px rgba(0,0,0,.26),0 0 0 1px rgba(255,215,170,.02),0 0 60px rgba(255,118,28,.045);opacity:0;will-change:translate,rotate,scale,opacity,filter;transition:width .62s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),height .62s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),border-radius .62s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),transform .42s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),box-shadow .35s ease,border-color .35s ease;z-index:3}
.project-bubble:nth-of-type(3n+1){--tilt:-2deg}.project-bubble:nth-of-type(3n+2){--tilt:1.5deg}.project-bubble:nth-of-type(3n){--tilt:-.7deg}.project-bubble:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:8%;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(255,227,193,.08);pointer-events:none;opacity:.8}.project-bubble:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-8%;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%,rgba(255,140,44,.18),transparent 60%);filter:blur(20px);opacity:.36;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .35s ease}.project-bubble:hover:after{opacity:.5}.project-bubble.is-expanded:before{display:none}.project-bubble.is-expanded:after{display:none}
.project-bubble:hover{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(0deg) scale(1.075);border-color:rgba(255,222,184,.42);box-shadow:0 30px 94px rgba(0,0,0,.34),0 0 0 8px rgba(255,198,140,.04),0 0 72px rgba(255,120,30,.12)}
.project-bubble.is-expanded{width:min(620px,74vw);height:410px;border-radius:36px;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(0deg);z-index:30;border-color:rgba(255,221,182,.34);box-shadow:0 40px 118px rgba(0,0,0,.52),0 0 0 1px rgba(255,221,182,.05),0 0 90px rgba(255,129,40,.08)}
.project-bubble.featured{border-color:rgba(255,158,78,.48)}
.project-bubble.featured:hover{border-color:rgba(255,183,108,.84);box-shadow:0 32px 96px rgba(0,0,0,.40),0 0 0 8px rgba(255,183,108,.06),0 0 86px rgba(255,118,28,.16)}
.bubble-media{position:absolute;inset:0;background:var(--bubble-bg,radial-gradient(circle at 50% 48%,#e0b46f 0 18%,#b66a2a 48%,#24150f 84%));overflow:hidden;filter:saturate(.9) brightness(.72) contrast(1.05);transition:filter .4s ease,transform .6s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}
.project-bubble:hover .bubble-media{filter:saturate(1.06) brightness(.83) contrast(1.04);transform:scale(1.03)}
.project-bubble.is-expanded .bubble-media{filter:saturate(1.02) brightness(.8) contrast(1.02);transform:scale(1)}
.bubble-media:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(circle at 52% 48%,rgba(255,221,162,.62) 0 22%,rgba(236,169,89,.18) 31%,rgba(158,80,29,.0) 56%),radial-gradient(circle at 66% 64%,rgba(255,213,138,.30) 0 11%,transparent 18%),radial-gradient(circle at 28% 22%,rgba(255,246,227,.22),transparent 24%),linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(0,0,0,.05),rgba(0,0,0,.28) 78%)}
.bubble-media:after{content:"";position:absolute;left:16%;top:14%;width:18%;height:18%;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,248,237,.36),rgba(255,248,237,0) 72%);opacity:.85}
.bubble-overlay{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(12,8,5,.02) 8%,rgba(24,14,8,.12) 38%,rgba(13,9,7,.70) 78%,rgba(10,8,7,.92));transition:background .5s ease}
.project-bubble.is-expanded .bubble-overlay{background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(14,10,8,.95) 0 44%,rgba(18,12,9,.46) 66%,rgba(18,12,9,.14))}
.bubble-content{position:absolute;left:25px;right:25px;bottom:22px;color:#fff;z-index:3;transition:all .48s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}
.bubble-kicker{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:15px;font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(255,255,255,.68);margin-bottom:8px}
.bubble-title{font-size:clamp(24px,2.6vw,42px);font-weight:500;letter-spacing:-.05em;line-height:.92}
.bubble-details{max-width:340px;margin-top:16px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.5;color:rgba(255,255,255,.72);opacity:0;transform:translateY(10px);pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .32s ease .03s,transform .52s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) .03s}
.project-bubble.is-expanded .bubble-content{left:30px;bottom:30px;right:auto;width:min(42%,235px)}
.project-bubble.is-expanded .bubble-details{opacity:1;transform:none}
.bubble-closehint{display:block;margin-top:15px;font-size:7px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(255,255,255,.46)}

.explorer-hud{position:absolute;z-index:9;left:18px;right:18px;bottom:16px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;gap:18px;pointer-events:none}
.explorer-hud-left,.explorer-hud-right{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-width:0}
.explorer-hint,.explorer-pos,.zoom-readout{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#a9acb2;background:rgba(12,13,15,.68);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);padding:9px 11px;border-radius:999px;white-space:nowrap;box-shadow:0 8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.12)}
.explorer-tools{display:flex;gap:6px;pointer-events:auto}
.explorer-tool{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);background:rgba(12,13,15,.78);color:#d9dbe0;display:grid;place-items:center;font:500 16px/1 Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:background .2s,border-color .2s,transform .2s}
.explorer-tool:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.09);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.32);transform:scale(1.06)}
.explorer-tool:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:2px}
.edge-indicator{position:absolute;z-index:8;pointer-events:none;opacity:0;transition:opacity .25s ease}
.edge-indicator.left,.edge-indicator.right{top:0;bottom:0;width:19%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(240,68,82,.09),transparent)}
.edge-indicator.left{left:0}.edge-indicator.right{right:0;transform:scaleX(-1)}
.edge-indicator.top,.edge-indicator.bottom{left:0;right:0;height:19%;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(240,68,82,.08),transparent)}
.edge-indicator.top{top:0}.edge-indicator.bottom{bottom:0;transform:scaleY(-1)}
.explorer-window.edge-left .edge-indicator.left,.explorer-window.edge-right .edge-indicator.right,.explorer-window.edge-top .edge-indicator.top,.explorer-window.edge-bottom .edge-indicator.bottom{opacity:1}

@media(max-width:700px){.explorer-window{height:650px;min-height:650px;border-radius:22px;touch-action:none}.explorer-chrome{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}.project-bubble{--bw:220px}.project-bubble.is-expanded{width:min(86vw,450px);height:340px;border-radius:28px}.project-bubble.is-expanded .bubble-content{width:46%;left:22px;bottom:22px}.bubble-details{font-size:11px}.explorer-pos{display:none}.year-chip .year-text{font-size:64px}.year-chip .year-fact{width:260px;font-size:11px;padding:12px 14px}}
@media(max-width:700px){.explorer-hud{left:10px;right:10px;bottom:10px}.explorer-hint{display:none}.zoom-readout{display:none}.explorer-tool{width:38px;height:38px}.explorer-hud-right{margin-left:auto}}

/* contact */
.contact{background:#f6f6f2;color:#111214;padding:clamp(85px,10vw,145px) 0 28px}.contact .eyebrow{color:#6e7075}.contact h2{margin:18px 0 0;font-size:clamp(48px,7vw,108px);line-height:.9;letter-spacing:-.065em;font-weight:500}.contact-link{display:inline-block;margin-top:35px;font-size:clamp(18px,2vw,28px);border-bottom:1px solid currentColor;padding-bottom:4px}.foot{margin-top:clamp(65px,8vw,110px);padding-top:18px;border-top:1px solid rgba(17,18,20,.15);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.13em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#777a80}

@media(max-width:1050px){.skill-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.cap-head,.workshop-head{grid-template-columns:1fr}.software{justify-content:flex-start}.about-card{grid-template-columns:1fr}.about-copy{min-height:0}.about-visual{min-height:330px}}
@media(max-width:700px){.nav{gap:14px}.hero-copy{flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start}.hero-meta{text-align:left}.skill-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.skill{min-height:220px}.workshop-grid,.portfolio-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.work-card,.project{border-radius:16px}.foot{flex-direction:column;gap:8px}.section{padding:78px 0}}


/* Scroll-build motion system: horizontal type + objects assembling from off-screen */
html,body{overflow-x:hidden}

.slide-clip{display:block;overflow:hidden;padding:.08em 0 .1em;margin:-.08em 0 -.1em}
.slide-piece{display:block;transform:translate3d(var(--slide-from,-112%),0,0);opacity:.001;will-change:transform,opacity;transition:transform 1.05s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),opacity .22s linear}
.slide-text.is-built .slide-piece{transform:translate3d(0,0,0);opacity:1}

.soft-build{opacity:0;transform:translate3d(var(--soft-x,0),var(--soft-y,24px),0);filter:blur(3px);transition:transform .95s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),opacity .42s ease,filter .7s ease;will-change:transform,opacity}
.soft-build.is-built{opacity:1;transform:none;filter:blur(0)}

.fly-build{--fx:0px;--fy:70px;--mx:0px;--my:10px;--fr:0deg;--mr:0deg;--fs:.92;--ms:1.01;--fly-delay:0s;--fly-dur:1.9s;opacity:0;transform:translate3d(var(--fx),var(--fy),0) rotate(var(--fr)) scale(var(--fs));filter:blur(9px);will-change:transform,opacity,filter}
.fly-build.is-built{animation:pageAssemble var(--fly-dur) var(--fly-delay) both}
@keyframes pageAssemble{
  0%{opacity:0;transform:translate3d(var(--fx),var(--fy),0) rotate(var(--fr)) scale(var(--fs));filter:blur(11px);animation-timing-function:cubic-bezier(.67,.01,.8,.2)}
  68%{opacity:.82;transform:translate3d(var(--mx),var(--my),0) rotate(var(--mr)) scale(var(--ms));filter:blur(1px);animation-timing-function:cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}
  100%{opacity:1;transform:translate3d(0,0,0) rotate(0deg) scale(1);filter:blur(0)}
}
.skill.fly-build{transform-origin:50% 100%}
.work-card.fly-build,.project.fly-build,.about-visual.fly-build{transform-origin:50% 50%}

.eyebrow.slide-text .slide-piece{transition-duration:.82s}
.section-title.slide-text .slide-piece,.contact h2.slide-text .slide-piece{transition-duration:1.12s}
.skill h3.slide-text .slide-piece,.work-card strong.slide-text .slide-piece,.project-title.slide-text .slide-piece{transition-duration:.9s}

.section-title:after,.contact h2:after{content:"";display:block;width:0;height:1px;margin-top:clamp(18px,2vw,28px);background:currentColor;opacity:.18;transition:width 1.05s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) .18s}
.section-title.is-built:after,.contact h2.is-built:after{width:100%}
.capabilities .section-title:after{opacity:.16}

.hero .topbar .logo,.hero .nav,.hero .hero-meta{opacity:0;will-change:transform,opacity}
.hero.hero-ready .topbar .logo{animation:heroLogo .95s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) .08s forwards}
.hero.hero-ready .nav{animation:heroNav .95s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) .17s forwards}
.hero.hero-ready .hero-meta{animation:heroMeta .95s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) .52s forwards}
@keyframes heroLogo{from{opacity:0;transform:translate3d(-90px,-60px,0) rotate(-8deg)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
@keyframes heroNav{from{opacity:0;transform:translate3d(120px,-50px,0)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
@keyframes heroMeta{from{opacity:0;transform:translate3d(100px,25px,0)}to{opacity:.75;transform:none}}

.skill:hover h3 .slide-piece,.work-card:hover strong .slide-piece,.project:hover .project-title .slide-piece{transform:translate3d(8px,0,0)}
.work-card:hover,.project:hover{transform:translateY(-4px)}

@media(max-width:700px){.fly-build{--fs:.98}.section-title.slide-text .slide-piece,.contact h2.slide-text .slide-piece{transition-duration:.9s}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.slide-piece,.soft-build,.fly-build,.hero .topbar .logo,.hero .nav,.hero .hero-meta,.section-title:after,.contact h2:after{animation:none!important;transition:none!important;transform:none!important;opacity:1!important;filter:none!important}}


/* Canvas archive: one graphics surface replaces the large transformed DOM layers. */
.canvas-archive .explorer-window{position:relative;min-height:720px;overflow:hidden;background:
  radial-gradient(900px 680px at 15% 18%,rgba(28,58,76,.22),transparent 72%),
  radial-gradient(850px 640px at 86% 18%,rgba(34,67,55,.18),transparent 72%),
  radial-gradient(900px 720px at 82% 86%,rgba(69,43,65,.16),transparent 72%),
  radial-gradient(780px 620px at 14% 84%,rgba(75,61,38,.13),transparent 72%),
  linear-gradient(145deg,#101316 0%,#0d1013 48%,#121417 100%);
  cursor:grab;touch-action:pan-y;contain:layout paint style}
.canvas-archive .explorer-window.is-dragging{cursor:grabbing}
.canvas-archive .explorer-window:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:2;background:radial-gradient(circle at center,transparent 52%,rgba(0,0,0,.11) 78%,rgba(0,0,0,.26) 100%)}
.canvas-archive .explorer-window:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:3;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.025)}
.archive-canvas{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;display:block;z-index:1}
.canvas-archive .explorer-hud{z-index:6}
.archive-help{position:absolute;z-index:6;left:50%;top:16px;translate:-50% 0;font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(255,255,255,.44);white-space:nowrap;pointer-events:none}
.archive-fact{position:absolute;z-index:12;width:min(390px,calc(100% - 30px));padding:18px 20px 19px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);border-radius:18px;background:rgba(14,17,20,.94);box-shadow:0 22px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.36);pointer-events:none;color:#f5f3ef;transform:translate3d(0,0,0)}
.archive-fact[hidden]{display:none}
.archive-fact-meta{display:block;margin-bottom:7px;font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(255,255,255,.46)}
.archive-fact-year{display:block;margin-bottom:9px;font-size:28px;line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.055em;font-weight:500}
.archive-fact-text{display:block;font-size:14px;line-height:1.5;color:rgba(255,255,255,.78)}
.canvas-archive .explorer-pos,.canvas-archive .zoom-readout,.canvas-archive .explorer-hint{background:rgba(11,14,17,.72);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.11)}
.canvas-archive .explorer-tool{background:rgba(11,14,17,.82);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.13)}
.canvas-archive .explorer-tool:hover{background:rgba(29,36,41,.92);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.25)}
@media(max-width:700px){.canvas-archive .explorer-window{min-height:620px}.archive-help{display:none}.archive-fact{width:min(330px,calc(100% - 24px));padding:15px 16px}.archive-fact-text{font-size:13px}}

/* YK identity: supplied section marks and a quieter, typeset hero lockup. */
.brand-home{display:block;flex:none;line-height:0}
.hero .topbar .logo{width:clamp(36px,3.2vw,46px);height:auto}
.hero:after{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(0,0,0,.28),rgba(0,0,0,.025) 35%,rgba(0,0,0,.28) 63%,rgba(0,0,0,.72))}
.hero-copy{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto;align-items:end;gap:clamp(32px,5vw,88px);bottom:clamp(38px,5vw,78px)}
.hero h1.hero-title{font-size:clamp(36px,4.9vw,80px);font-weight:400;letter-spacing:-.055em;line-height:1.02;max-width:1100px;min-width:0}
.hero-title .hero-name{font-size:1.38em;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:-.065em;line-height:1.05}
.hero-title .hero-discipline{font-size:1em;font-weight:400}
.hero-title .slide-clip:first-child{margin-bottom:.20em}
.hero-title .slide-clip{padding-right:.05em}
.hero .hero-meta{position:relative;margin:0 0 6px;padding-top:20px;max-width:none;min-width:200px;letter-spacing:-.025em;text-transform:none;text-align:left;font-size:clamp(17px,1.48vw,23px);font-weight:400;line-height:1.32;color:#f4f4f0}
.hero-meta:before{content:"";display:block;position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:46px;height:1px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.55)}
.hero-meta-line{display:block;white-space:nowrap}
.hero-meta-amp{color:rgba(255,255,255,.62)}
@keyframes heroMeta{from{opacity:0;transform:translate3d(64px,14px,0)}to{opacity:.95;transform:none}}
.section-brand{width:84px;height:75px;margin:0 0 clamp(23px,2.2vw,30px);display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:flex-start;pointer-events:none}
.section-brand img{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;object-position:left bottom}
.section-brand--about{width:84px;height:74px}
.section-brand--capabilities{width:110px;height:70px}
.section-brand--workshop{width:88px;height:75px}
.section-brand--work{width:96px;height:80px}
/* Section marks join the existing section reveal but need no expensive blur. */
.section-brand.soft-build{filter:none;transition:transform 1.1s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),opacity .65s ease;will-change:auto}
.about-copy .intro{margin-top:36px}
.footer-signature{display:flex;gap:22px;align-items:center}
.footer-signature img{width:32px;height:auto;flex:none}
.foot{align-items:center}
@media(max-width:1100px){

  .hero .hero-meta{min-width:175px;font-size:18px}
}
@media(max-width:850px){

}
@media(max-width:700px){
  .hero-copy{gap:28px;bottom:36px}
  .hero h1.hero-title{font-size:clamp(26px,7.8vw,46px);letter-spacing:-.05em}
  .hero-title .hero-name{font-size:1.55em}
  .hero-title .slide-clip:first-child{margin-bottom:.24em}
  .hero .hero-meta{font-size:16px;line-height:1.35}
  .section-brand{margin-bottom:23px}

  .section-brand--capabilities{width:92px;height:59px}
  .section-brand--workshop{width:74px;height:63px}

}
@media(max-width:370px){
  .hero h1.hero-title{font-size:24px}
  
}
@media(max-height:560px) and (min-width:701px){
  .hero{min-height:570px}

}

/* Section identity in the navigation. All four links remain visible on mobile. */
.hero .topbar{align-items:center;gap:28px;padding-block:22px}
.hero .nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:clamp(20px,2.5vw,40px);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase}
.hero .nav .nav-item{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:11px;min-width:58px;min-height:62px;padding:6px 3px 8px;opacity:.76;color:#fff;transition:opacity .22s ease}
.nav-symbol{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:48px;height:29px;flex:none;transform:translateY(0);transition:transform .3s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}
.nav-symbol img{display:block;width:auto;height:100%;max-width:100%;object-fit:contain}
.hero .nav .nav-item--capabilities .nav-symbol{width:51px}
.nav-label{display:block;white-space:nowrap;line-height:1.15;text-align:center}
.hero .nav .nav-item::after{content:"";position:absolute;bottom:0;left:calc(50% - 7px);width:14px;height:1px;background:var(--accent);transform:scaleX(0);transition:transform .25s ease}
.hero .nav .nav-item:hover,.hero .nav .nav-item:focus-visible{opacity:1}
.hero .nav .nav-item:hover .nav-symbol,.hero .nav .nav-item:focus-visible .nav-symbol{transform:translateY(-3px)}
.hero .nav .nav-item:hover::after,.hero .nav .nav-item:focus-visible::after{transform:scaleX(1)}
.hero .nav .nav-item:focus-visible{outline:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.6);outline-offset:6px;border-radius:3px}
.brand-home:focus-visible{outline:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.6);outline-offset:8px;border-radius:3px}
@media(max-width:700px){
  .hero .topbar{gap:14px;padding:20px var(--pad);align-items:center}
  .hero .topbar .logo{width:32px}
  .hero .nav{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:4px;flex:1;min-width:0;max-width:420px;font-size:clamp(7px,2vw,9px);letter-spacing:.08em}
  .hero .nav .nav-item{min-width:0;min-height:55px;gap:9px;padding:5px 0 7px}
  .hero .nav .nav-symbol{width:39px;height:24px}
  .hero .nav .nav-item--capabilities .nav-symbol{width:41px}
}
@media(max-width:360px){
  .hero .topbar{gap:10px;padding-inline:16px}
  .hero .topbar .logo{width:28px}
  .hero .nav{font-size:7px;letter-spacing:.07em;gap:3px}
  .hero .nav .nav-symbol{height:22px}
  .hero .nav .nav-item--capabilities .nav-symbol{width:37px}
}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  .hero .nav .nav-item,.nav-symbol,.hero .nav .nav-item::after{transition:none}
  .hero .nav .nav-item:hover .nav-symbol,.hero .nav .nav-item:focus-visible .nav-symbol{transform:none}
}




/* 2026 responsive + rendering pass */
.hero .topbar{
  position:fixed;left:0;right:0;top:0;z-index:1000;
  width:100%;padding:16px var(--pad);align-items:center;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(5,5,6,.42),rgba(5,5,6,0));
  transition:background .32s ease,backdrop-filter .32s ease,border-color .32s ease,padding .32s ease;
  border-bottom:1px solid transparent;
}
body.is-scrolled .hero .topbar{
  background:rgba(8,9,11,.76);backdrop-filter:blur(16px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(16px);
  border-bottom-color:rgba(255,255,255,.08);padding-top:10px;padding-bottom:10px;
}
.hero .nav{margin-left:auto;justify-content:flex-end;align-items:center}
.hero .nav .nav-item{min-width:64px}
.nav-symbol{width:44px;height:26px}
.hero .nav .nav-item--capabilities .nav-symbol{width:47px}
.contact-location{margin-top:14px;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#777a80}
.archive-canvas{image-rendering:auto;transform:translateZ(0);backface-visibility:hidden}
.canvas-archive .explorer-window{transform:translateZ(0);backface-visibility:hidden;overscroll-behavior:contain}

@media(max-width:700px){
  :root{--pad:20px}
  .hero{min-height:720px}
  .hero .topbar{padding:10px 14px;gap:8px;background:rgba(7,8,10,.34)}
  body.is-scrolled .hero .topbar{padding-top:8px;padding-bottom:8px;background:rgba(7,8,10,.84)}
  .hero .topbar .logo{width:26px}
  .hero .nav{gap:0;max-width:none;width:100%;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.07em}
  .hero .nav .nav-item{min-width:0;min-height:43px;gap:4px;padding:2px 0 4px}
  .hero .nav .nav-symbol{width:27px;height:17px}
  .hero .nav .nav-item--capabilities .nav-symbol{width:30px}
  .nav-label{font-size:8px}
  .hero-copy{left:20px;right:20px;bottom:42px;gap:26px}
  .hero h1.hero-title{font-size:clamp(34px,9.8vw,48px);line-height:1.00}
  .hero .hero-meta{font-size:18px;line-height:1.3}
  .section{padding:92px 0}
  .section-title{font-size:clamp(46px,13vw,68px);line-height:.94}
  .intro{font-size:18px;line-height:1.58;margin-top:26px}
  .eyebrow{font-size:10px}
  .about-copy .intro{margin-top:28px}
  .about-visual{min-height:380px}
  .section-brand{transform-origin:left bottom}
  .section-brand--about{width:64px;height:56px}
  .section-brand--capabilities{width:78px;height:50px}
  .section-brand--workshop{width:64px;height:55px}
  .section-brand--work{width:68px;height:56px}
  .skill{min-height:260px;padding:26px 22px 28px}
  .skill h3{font-size:29px}.skill p{font-size:15px;line-height:1.55}.skill-tags span{font-size:9px}
  .workshop-grid{gap:18px}.work-card{min-height:260px;aspect-ratio:auto;padding:24px}.work-card strong{font-size:36px}.work-card small,.image-note{font-size:9px}
  .project-explorer{margin-left:-20px;margin-right:-20px}
  .explorer-chrome{padding:0 20px 14px;font-size:9px}
  .canvas-archive .explorer-window{height:72svh;min-height:560px;border-radius:0;border-left:0;border-right:0}
  .canvas-archive .explorer-hud{left:14px;right:14px;bottom:14px}
  .explorer-tool{width:42px;height:42px;font-size:17px}
  .archive-fact{font-size:14px}
  .contact{padding-top:96px}.contact h2{font-size:clamp(54px,14vw,74px)}.contact-link{font-size:22px}.contact-location{font-size:11px;margin-top:13px}
  .foot{font-size:10px;line-height:1.5}
}
@media(max-width:380px){
  :root{--pad:17px}
  .hero .topbar{padding-inline:10px}.hero .topbar .logo{width:23px}
  .hero .nav .nav-symbol{width:24px;height:15px}.hero .nav .nav-item--capabilities .nav-symbol{width:27px}
  .nav-label{font-size:7px;letter-spacing:.04em}
  .hero h1.hero-title{font-size:32px}.hero .hero-meta{font-size:17px}
  .project-explorer{margin-left:-17px;margin-right:-17px}
}

<body>
<main>
<section class="hero" id="top">
  <video autoplay muted loop playsinline poster="data:image/jpeg;base64,"><source src="data:video/mp4;base64,
